items.text: Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli basuka, bamisa emathafeni akwaMowabi ngaseJordani ngaseJeriko.
UBalaki indodana kaSipori wakubona konke u-Israyeli akwenza kuma-Amori.
UMowabi wayesesaba kakhulu abantu, ngokuba babebaningi; uMowabi wakhathazeka ngenxa yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
UMowabi wayesethi kumalunga akwaMidiyani: “Manje leli sixuku liyakuqeda njengezinkomo ezisihaqileyo, lidle utshani basendle; UBalaki indodana kaSipori wayeyinkosi yakwaMowabi ngaleso sikhathi.

Wathuma izithunywa kuBileyamu indodana kaBeyori kuPhethori osemfuleni wezwe labantwana babantu bakubo ukuba zimbize, zithi: “Bheka, kuphume abantu eGibithe; bheka, zisibekela ubuso bomhlaba, futhi zihlala phambi Kwami.

Woza-ke, ungiqalekisele laba bantu; ngokuba banamandla kunami; mhlawumbe ngizonqoba, ukuze sibahlule futhi sibaxoshe ezweni; ngokuba ngiyazi ukuthi ombusisayo ubusisiwe, nalowo omqalekisayo uqalekisiwe.
Abadala bakwaMowabi namalunga akwaMidiyani asuka ephethe umvuzo wokubhula esandleni sawo; zafika kuBileyamu, zakhuluma kuye amazwi kaBalaki.
Wathi kubo: “Hlalani lapha namuhla ebusuku, ngizakunibikela izwi, njengalokho uJehova eyakukhuluma kimi; izikhulu zakwaMowabi zahlala kuBileyamu.
UNkulunkulu wayesefika kuBileyamu, wathi: “Angobani lawa madoda onawo na?
UBileyamu wayesethi kuNkulunkulu: “UBalaki indodana kaSipori, inkosi yakwaMowabi, wathumela kimi ukuba athi:
Bheka, kuphume abantu eGibithe, bembese ubuso bomhlaba; woza, ungiqalekisele bona; mhlawumbe ngizokwazi ukubanqoba ngibaxoshe.
UNkulunkulu wasesithi kuBalami: Ungahambi lawo; Akumelwe uqalekise abantu, ngoba babusisiwe.
UBileyamu wayeseqeda ekuseni, wathi kuzo izikhulu zikaBalaki: “Hambani niye ezweni lakini, ngokuba uJehova uyala ukungivumela ukuba ngihambe nani.
Zase zisukuma izikhulu zakwaMowabi, zaya kuBalaki, zathi: “UBileyamu uyala ukuza nathi.
UBalaki waphinda wathuma izikhulu, ezihloniphekayo kunazo.
Zafika kuBileyamu zathi kuye: “Usho kanje uBalaki, indodana kaSipori, uthi: ‘Ungavimbeli lutho ukuba uze kimi.
Ngokuba ngiyakukwenza ube nodumo olukhulu, ngikwenze konke ongitshela khona; woza, ungiqalekisele laba bantu.
UBileyamu waphendula, wathi ezincekwini zikaBalaki: “Uma uBalaki efuna ukunginika indlu yakhe igcwele isiliva negolide, anginakweqa izwi likaJehova uNkulunkulu wami ngenze okuncane noma okukhulu.
Hlala lapha lalobubusuku, ukuze ngazi ukuthi iNkosi izakutshoni kimi.
UNkulunkulu wafika kuBileyamu ebusuku, wathi kuye: “Uma la madoda efika ukukubiza, sukuma uhambe nawo; kodwa nokho izwi engizolikhuluma kini nize nilenze.
UBileyamu waqeda ekuseni, wabophela imbongolo yakhe, wahamba nezikhulu zakwaMowabi.
Intukuthelo kaNkulunkulu yavutha ngoba wahamba, futhi ingelosi yeNkosi yema endleleni yesitha ngokumelene naye. Wagibela imbongolo yakhe, nezinceku zakhe ezimbili zinaye.
Imbongolo yayibona ingelosi kaJehova imi endleleni iphethe inkemba yayo ehoshiweyo esandleni sayo; imbongolo yachezuka endleleni, yaya ensimini; uBileyamu wayishaya imbongolo wayishintsha endleleni.
Kodwa ingelosi yeNkosi yema endleleni yezivini, ugange ngalapha nogange ngalapha.
Imbongolo yabona ingelosi kaJehova, yazicindezela odongeni nonyawo lukaBileyamu odongeni, wamshaya futhi.
Ingelosi kaJehova yahamba yema endaweni ewumngcingo, lapho kwakungekho ndlela yokuphendukela ngakwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo.
Imbongolo yabona ingelosi yeNkosi yawela phansi phansi kukaBileyamu; ulaka lukaBileyamu lwavutha, wayishaya imbongolo ngodondolo.
I Nkosi yasivula umlomo wembongolo, yathi kuBalami: Ngenzeni kuwe ukuthi ungitshaye kathathu?
UBileyamu wayesethi embongolweni: “Ngokuba udlale ngami, sengathi ngabe nginenkemba esandleni sami, ngokuba manje sengifuna ukukubulala.
Imbongolo yathi kuBileyamu: “Angisiyo yini imbongolo yakho ohlezi phezu kwayo kusukela ngingowakho kuze kube namuhla na?” ngake ngakwenza lokho kuwe Wathi: Cha!
UJehova wavula amehlo kaBileyamu, wayibona ingelosi kaJehova imi endleleni iphethe inkemba yayo ehoshiweyo; wagebisa ikhanda, wawa ngobuso.
Ingelosi kaJehova yathi kuye: “Uyishayeleni imbongolo yakho kathathu na? bheka, ngiphumile ukulwa nawe, ngokuba indlela yakho imbi phambi kwami.
Imbongolo yangibona, yachezuka kimi kathathu;
UBileyamu wayesethi kuyo ingelosi kaJehova: “Ngonile; ngokuba bengingazi ukuthi umi endleleni ngokumelene nami; ngizobe sengibuyela kuwe manje uma ungakuthandi.
Ingelosi kaJehova yathi kuBileyamu: “Hamba namadoda; kodwa kuphela izwi engizolikhuluma kuwe, okufanele ulikhulume. UBileyamu wahamba nezikhulu zikaBalaki.
UBalaki esezwile ukuthi uBileyamu usefikile, waphuma ukumhlangabeza emzini wakwaMowabi osemngceleni we-Arinoni, ekugcineni ogwini.
UBalaki wathi kuBileyamu: “Angithumanga nokuthuma kuwe ukuba ngikubize na? kungani ungezanga kimi ngingakwazi yini ukuKuphakamisela enkazimulweni ngokweqiniso?
UBileyamu wayesethi kuBalaki: “Bheka, ngize kuwe; nginamandla okukhuluma manje? izwi uNkulunkulu alifaka emlonyeni wami, ngiyakulikhuluma.
UBileyamu wahamba noBalaki, bafika eKiriyati-Husoti.
UBalaki wanikela ngezinkomo nezimvu, wakuthuma kuBileyamu nakuzo izikhulu ezazinaye.
Ngangomuso uBalaki wamthatha uBileyamu, wamyisa ezindaweni eziphakemeyo zikaBali, ukuze abone ukuphela kwabantu elapho.
